description: Record that a repository's region agreements now stand on a newer tree. Nothing else does: merge-turn-land records no revision mark, because a mark is append-only while a landed base can still be corrected. A registered parent of any project with an agreement in the repository, open or closed (any registered parent while the repository has none), records the move after reading the landed base (its merge-turn-land answer or merge-turn-show), before answering or relying on an agreement standing on the older tree. Until then a late acceptance on the older tree stands. The move reopens the proposed and agreed agreements on --from-revision; settling one is then refused as agreement_revision_stale until a party reaffirms it. One revision has one successor, so only the first move starts at the proposal's revision: every later move starts at the end of the recorded chain, which region-show reports as currentRevision and a refusal names. A move the chain already holds answers alreadyRecorded and writes no new mark; a move from a revision no live agreement stands on and no recorded move reaches is refused.

Carrying accepts your side on the new tree; the other side's acceptance is not carried, and reaffirmation.awaitingAcceptance names its parent, the reason and the region-settle command that agrees it. name: dag-conflict-sweep
summary: measures, with git merge-tree, every pair of the plan's live heads and each live head against the tip of the branch it lands on, and records the observations, the declaration drift (a conflict on a path a node did not declare) and a ledger row naming what prompted the sweep (a landing, a receipt, or this command). A head is the one named with --head, else the node's current accepted head, else the HEAD of the checkout its child works in; the relay never fetches, so a commit the checkout lacks is a member that says so. A measurement: nothing waits for it and nothing running is stopped

options.help: the project's registered parent
an absolute path of the local checkout to measure in; the parent_cwd of the plan's relationships by default
what prompted the sweep: landing, receipt or manual (the default)
the node whose landing or receipt prompted the sweep; also names the manifest whose frozen base is the tip when no --target is given
repository@ref whose tip every head is measured against (repeatable); the base frozen in the manifest of --node's current execution by default
NODE=SHA: measure the node at this commit (repeatable)

name: dag-cap-basis-record
summary: records the evidence (W and S minutes and where each came from) that a runs ceiling above the standing cap of 6 rests on; the scheduler honours such a ceiling only for a limit revision that has one. It decides no ceiling

options.help: the task that declared the limit or the registered parent of its project
the plan the recorder coordinates: for a project limit it is held to that project and fenced by its epoch; once a plan of the project is under an epoch a basis without a plan is refused
the coordinator epoch this session holds (dag-coordinator-claim answers it); a write from another epoch is refused stale_coordinator_epoch. 0 names none, which only a plan nobody claimed takes

name: dag-coordinator-claim
summary: raises the coordinator epoch of a DAG plan for a new parent session: the next number after the newest claim, recorded with the parent binding it was made under, the task and the session nonce. The actor must hold the live parent binding of the plan's project. Repeating the call with the same nonce while it is the newest claim answers the same epoch; the nonce of a session that was replaced is stale_coordinator_epoch. A session claims before its first decision and sends the epoch it was given as --expect-epoch

options.help: the project's parent task
names this session once and is never reused (letters, digits and . _ : -)
the plan's project, needed only while the plan has no revision

name: dag-adopt
summary: binds a live child to the parent that replaced the node's parent: the successor relationship (registered with the old one superseded, same issue and child, held by the actor) becomes an execution of the node of kind parent_handover under the manifest the child was released with. Nothing is created, opened or reserved; a node with an acceptance is refused. Repeating it is a replay

options.help: the adopting parent, who holds the successor relationship
the coordinator epoch this session holds (dag-coordinator-claim answers it); a write from another epoch is refused stale_coordinator_epoch. 0 names none, which only a plan nobody claimed takes

name: dag-restart
summary: what the store says to a parent that starts again, rebuilt from the store alone with no clock: the newest coordinator claim and whether the actor holds it, and for every node somebody owns what to do (adopt a live child, run dag-adopt, reconcile an effect whose outcome is unknown by replaying the same request or observing, needs_operator, or none). Reads only

options.help: the task that starts again
